# sexual orientation value

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:sexualOrientationValue`](gmeow-sexualOrientationValue.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/sexualOrientationValue>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/sexuality`](../../slices/sexuality.md)

The [`gmeow:SexualOrientationValue`](../classes/gmeow-SexualOrientationValue.md) a sexual-orientation facet asserts (functional per facet). A predefined individual or a fresh one with [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label); the single path to the value.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to point a [`gmeow:SexualOrientation`](../classes/gmeow-SexualOrientation.md) facet at the one value it asserts — functional per facet, so a single facet names exactly one orientation value; model a change of orientation as a new facet, not a second value here.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it as the romantic-orientation path (that is [`gmeow:romanticOrientationValue`](gmeow-romanticOrientationValue.md)) and avoid forcing the long tail into the seed list; an orientation not seeded is a fresh [`gmeow:SexualOrientationValue`](../classes/gmeow-SexualOrientationValue.md) individual carrying its own [rdfs:label.](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label.)

### How to use

- Reference a seeded [`gmeow:SexualOrientationValue`](../classes/gmeow-SexualOrientationValue.md) or mint a fresh labelled individual, and let the facet carry the disclosure facets; when the value is held only loosely, record [`gmeow:hasDeterminacy`](gmeow-hasDeterminacy.md) [`gmeow:determinacyFuzzy`](../individuals/gmeow-determinacyFuzzy.md) on the facet rather than on this functional link.

### Examples

- ex:lillithSexOrient [`gmeow:sexualOrientationValue`](gmeow-sexualOrientationValue.md) [`gmeow:orientBisexual`](../individuals/gmeow-orientBisexual.md).
